index.title: Envoys
index.description: Agents people can reach on chat platforms, each speaking through an account you connected.
index.emptyBody: Connect an account on a chat platform and pick the agent that speaks through it. The agent shows up here.

add.title: Connect an account
add.description: First pick the agent that speaks through the account. Next you pick the platform and set the account up.
add.footnote_one: {{count}} agent. Agents are created and edited in Apps.
add.footnote_other: {{count}} agents. Agents are created and edited in Apps.

newBot.title: Connect an account on {{app}} for {{agent}}
newBot.description: {{agent}} speaks through this account in every chat it is in. You can switch the account to another agent later in one step.
newBot.name: Account name in {{app}}
newBot.nameHint: People see this name in groups and @mention it.
newBot.scanBody: {{app}} creates the {{bot}} account and connects it to Rome.
newBot.delegateDescription: {{agent}} answers on your behalf from your own account. People still see you; the agent is your delegate.
newBot.signInBody: Sign in to your own account in the {{app}} app. {{agent}} then answers on your behalf.

overview.noBots: {{agent}} speaks through no account yet. Connect one on a chat platform, then invite it to any group or DM.

chat.shared_one: {{bots}} is in this chat too. It is one chat with one history. Each agent sees what the platform delivers to its own account, which may not include the other agents' messages.
chat.shared_other: {{bots}} are in this chat too. It is one chat with one history. Each agent sees what the platform delivers to its own account, which may not include the other agents' messages.
chat.settings: Reply rule for this account here: answers when @mentioned · replies in thread
chat.override: Who answers: each account's agent. There is no per-chat choice of agent.

activity.description: What was said to and by {{agent}} across its chats, newest first.

settings.introduce: Introduce itself when added to a group
settings.introduceBody: Posts one short hello with what it can help with.
settings.moveConfirm_one: Switch {{bot}} to {{to}}? {{to}} answers in its {{count}} chat from now on. It reads the chat's history as context and starts with fresh working memory.
settings.moveConfirm_other: Switch {{bot}} to {{to}}? {{to}} answers in its {{count}} chats from now on. It reads each chat's history as context and starts with fresh working memory.
settings.unlinkConfirm: Unlink {{agent}} from {{bot}}? {{bot}} stays connected, but Rome stops listening to its messages until you link an agent again.

choose.title: Connect an account for {{agent}}
choose.description: Pick whose account it is and the platform it lives on. An agent can speak through any number of accounts.
choose.ownBody: An account made for {{agent}}. {{agent}} speaks as that account.
choose.delegateBody: {{agent}} answers from your account on your behalf, as your delegate.
choose.delegateSetup: Sign in by scanning a QR code in the {{app}} app

feishu.name: Feishu
feishu.setup: Scan a QR code in the Feishu app
feishu.invite: Open a group, then Settings, Group bots, Add bot, and pick {{bot}}. To start a DM, search for {{bot}} in Feishu. Chats appear here on their own.

lark.name: Lark
lark.setup: Scan a QR code in the Lark app
lark.invite: Open a group, then Settings, Group bots, Add bot, and pick {{bot}}. To start a DM, search for {{bot}} in Lark. Chats appear here on their own.

telegram.name: Telegram
telegram.invite: Add {{bot}} to a group from its member list, or search for {{bot}} in Telegram to start a DM. Chats appear here on their own.
telegram.tokenHint: Create the bot with @BotFather in Telegram, then paste the token it gives you.

discord.name: Discord
discord.setup: Paste a bot token from the Discord Developer Portal
discord.invite: Invite {{bot}} to a server with its install link, then @mention it in a channel. Chats appear here on their own.
discord.tokenHint: Create an application in the Discord Developer Portal, add a bot to it, and paste the bot's token.

wechat.name: WeChat
wechat.setup: Scan a QR code in the WeChat app
wechat.invite: Add {{bot}} to a group from its member list, or message {{bot}} directly in WeChat. Chats appear here on their own.

unlinked.title: Connected, no agent
unlinked.description: Rome has access to these accounts, but no agent speaks through them, so Rome does not listen to their messages. Link an agent to start.
